name: AVB81
description: Automated bird monitoring plays a crucial role in ecoinformatics and biodiversity conservation. Despite significant advancements in fine-grained visual classification, targets in complex wild environments frequently encounter interferences such as long capture distances, severe visual occlusion, and strong background noise, rendering single-modal perception highly susceptible to performance bottlenecks. To advance research in audiovisual multimodal bird classification, this paper introduces AVB81, a multimodal dataset tailored for fine-grained bird recognition.
